# PowerFootball-2D — Semantic Repository Map & RAG Router

**Godot 4.7 · GDScript 2.0 · Top-Down Football Simulation**
"Dwarf Fortress with a football." Simple overhead visuals; deep systemic simulation.

---

## 1. Vision & Architectural Invariants

<core_invariants>
- **docs/CORE_INVARIANTS.md** — Canonical single source of truth: Engine lock, simulation stack, choke points, and physics/AI laws.
- **docs/API_SURFACE.md** — Auto-generated public API surface map across all 76+ scripts, exports, signals, and methods.
- **docs/ANTI_PATTERNS.md** — Curated anti-pattern and hallucination corpus for autonomous agent reasoning.
- **docs/MATH_SOLVERS.md** — Ground-truth mathematical solvers catalog with exact formulas, proofs, and GDScript reference code.
- **docs/SYMBOLS.json** — Complete line-indexed symbol map across all 76 classes, 764 methods, 925 properties, and 52 signals.
- **docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json** — Static bidirectional dependency DAG and blast radius graph.
- **POWERFOOTBALL_MASTER_VISION.md** — Master design vision, 5-layer simulation stack, systems design, and North Star.
- **ROADMAP.md** — Tactical `[ ]`/`[x]` feature checklist across 5 development phases.
- **docs/course_implementation_specification.md** — Course-derived reference specification (READ-ONLY): FSMs, formulas, gotchas.
- **AGENTS.md** — Agent onboarding & protocol for Google Antigravity and Gemini context caching.
- **CLAUDE.md** — Agent onboarding & entry point for Claude Code sessions.
- **AGENTS_ERRATA.md** — Cross-agent shared memory, error logs, and pending rule proposals.
</core_invariants>

---

## 2. Five-Layer Simulation Stack (Semantic Routing)

<layer_1_physics>
### Layer 1 — Physics & Kinematics
Ball physics, pseudo-3D height trajectory, player kinematic body, turning penalties, and collision bounding.

- **entities/ball/Pseudo3DBall.gd** — Pseudo-3D ball physics solver (z-axis, gravity, proportional friction, shadow scaling).
- **entities/ball/BallState.gd** — Base state for ball FSM.
- **entities/ball/BallStateFactory.gd** — Ball state instantiation factory.
- **entities/ball/states/FlightState.gd** — Ball in airborne parabolic trajectory.
- **entities/ball/states/GroundRollState.gd** — Ball rolling on pitch surface with proportional friction drag.
- **entities/ball/states/PossessionState.gd** — Ball attached to carrier dribble offset.
- **entities/ball/states/DeadBallState.gd** — Ball stationary during set pieces or stoppages.
- **entities/player/HeavyPlayerController.gd** — Player kinematic body, acceleration curves, turning penalties, stamina, input resolution.
- **entities/player/PlayerState.gd** — Base player state machine class.
- **entities/player/PlayerStateFactory.gd** — Player state machine factory.
- **entities/player/states/MoveState.gd** — Off-ball running and pursuit steering.
- **entities/player/states/DribbleState.gd** — Close ball control and continuous possession magnetism.
- **entities/player/states/IdleState.gd** — Deceleration to rest and stationary stance.
- **entities/player/states/ChargeKickState.gd** — Kick power charge and Gaussian scatter calculation.
- **entities/player/states/TackleState.gd** — Slide/standing challenge execution and recovery delay.
- **entities/player/states/GoalkeeperDiveState.gd** — Goalkeeper commitment, dive velocity, and save window.
- **entities/player/states/AerialState.gd** — Jump timing, aerial contest, and heading resolution.
- **entities/player/states/ShotLockState.gd** — Travel-direction carry lock before striking.
- **entities/player/states/ThrowInState.gd** — Sideline throw-in positioning and delivery.
- **entities/player/states/PenaltyKickState.gd** — Penalty spot execution and run-up.
- **entities/player/states/SetPieceFreezeState.gd** — Wall and defensive positioning freeze during dead balls.
- **shared/CollisionLayers.gd** — Bitmask constants (Layer 1 World, Layer 2 Players, Layer 3 Ball, Layer 4 Hitboxes).
- **pitch/PitchBoundary.gd** — Touchlines, goal lines, ball out-of-bounds detection.
- **pitch/GoalZone.gd** — Goal net detection areas and scorer attribution.
- **pitch/PitchMarkings.gd** — Pitch line drawing and dimensions.
- **pitch/PitchScene.gd** — Pitch root scene managing declarative 22-player squad, match coordinator, and headless simulation telemetry harness.
- **pitch/SetPieceCoordinator.gd** — Set-piece positioning, wall placement, and restart triggers.
- **pitch/PenaltyShootoutCoordinator.gd** — Post-match penalty shootout turn resolution.
</layer_1_physics>

<layer_2_match_ai>
### Layer 2 — Match AI & Spatial Navigation
Spatial indexing, utility scoring, time-sliced decision engines, dynamic formation anchors, and officiating.

- **autoloads/MatchWorldModel.gd** — Global spatial position cache of 22 players + ball; computes shared team defensive line depth (`defensive_line_x`).
- **entities/player/PlayerBrain.gd** — Utility-scored decision engine running on 15-frame stagger; writes `movement_intent` and `wants_sprint`.
- **shared/PassUtilityScorer.gd** — Pass candidate utility scoring (lane safety, receiver openness, forward progress, trust modifier).
- **shared/UtilityMath.gd** — Geometric interception solver, lane raycast/occlusion math, sigmoid and exponential transforms.
- **shared/FormationAnchorMath.gd** — Compactness lerping and phase-dependent dynamic anchor calculations (In Possession / Out of Possession / Transition).
- **shared/FormationLibrary.gd** — Standard tactical formations (4-4-2, 4-3-3, 3-5-2, etc.) and anchor coordinate maps.
- **shared/FormationRegistry.gd** — Formation catalog and lookup helper.
- **shared/PlayerRoleConfig.gd** — Data-driven role tuning resource (`anchor_weight`, chase aggression, open space bias).
- **entities/goalkeeper/GoalkeeperDiveBrain.gd** — Goalkeeper shot trajectory anticipation, dive commitment, and intercept triggers.
- **entities/referee/MatchReferee.gd** — Foul evaluation, card thresholds, penalty awards, and whistle execution.
- **entities/referee/OffsideDetector.gd** — Second-last defender line tracking and pass-release offside validation.
- **entities/referee/MatchOfficialCrew.gd** — Complete 4-official referee crew coordinator.
- **entities/referee/WhistleSynthesizer.gd** — Procedural referee whistle sound synthesizer.
- **entities/manager/ManagerDirector.gd** — In-match tactical shifts, pressing tempo overrides, formation adjustments.
</layer_2_match_ai>

<layer_3_match_social>
### Layer 3 — Match Social & Dynamic Psychology
Player mood, slump/streak momentum, dynamic trust relationships, and individual match ratings.

- **entities/player/MoodSystem.gd** — Player form states (SLUMP / NORMAL / STREAK) modifying kick scatter and decision confidence.
- **entities/player/TrustSystem.gd** — In-match dynamic passing trust and chemistry modifier.
- **shared/PlayerRatingCalculator.gd** — Dynamic 1.0–10.0 performance rating algorithm based on completed passes, tackles, saves, and errors.
- **autoloads/MatchStatsTracker.gd** — Per-player and per-team match event accumulator (shots, passes, possession, fouls).
</layer_3_match_social>

<layer_4_club_world>
### Layer 4 — Club World & Persistent Entities
Persistent player profiles, manager personalities, team rosters, league databases, and JSON ingestion schemas.

- **shared/PlayerData.gd** — Persistent player attributes (speed, passing, tackling), traits, and long-term relationships.
- **shared/TeamData.gd** — Team identity, tactics, lineup indices, shirt colors, and stadium parameters.
- **shared/TeamManagementData.gd** — Lineup management, roster changes, and bench assignments.
- **shared/LeagueData.gd** — League table, fixtures, season standings, and division parameters.
- **shared/ManagerData.gd** — Manager personality profile, tactical preferences, and adaptability.
- **shared/RefereeData.gd** — Referee strictness, foul bias, card leniency, and historical profile.
- **shared/PlayerFactory.gd** — Procedural player generation and default roster builder.
- **autoloads/DataLoader.gd** — JSON database ingestion for players, teams, and leagues.
- **autoloads/ManagerLoader.gd** — Manager database JSON loader.
- **autoloads/RefereeLoader.gd** — Referee database JSON loader.
- **docs/json-schema.md** — Formal specification for external JSON rosters, traits, and club databases.
</layer_4_club_world>

<layer_5_narrative>
### Layer 5 — Narrative, Presentation & User Interface
Press office reactions, touchline dialogue, broadcast HUD, floating labels, match camera, and menus.

- **entities/manager/PressOffice.gd** — Match narrative generation, post-game quotes, press controversy.
- **ui/TouchlineBubble.gd** — Animated manager touchline reaction bubbles responding to match events.
- **ui/HUD.gd** — Match clock, scoreboard, player nameplates, and minimap HUD coordinator.
- **ui/ActionText.gd** — Floating floating action indicators (PASS, SHOT, TACKLE, SAVE).
- **ui/FormationDiagram.gd** — Tactical formation pitch diagram renderer.
- **ui/MatchStatsUI.gd** — Full-time match summary, shot statistics, and player ratings display.
- **pitch/MatchCamera.gd** — Camera tracking modes (BALL_FOLLOW, DYNAMIC, FULL_FIELD).
- **pitch/Minimap.gd** — Real-time 2D radar displaying player dots and ball position.
- **entities/player/FacingArrow.gd** — Player orientation and pass/kick direction indicator.
- **ui/MainMenu.gd** — Main entry screen (Kick Off, Practice, Career, Options).
- **ui/KickOffMenu.gd** — Team selection and match setup.
- **ui/OptionsMenu.gd** — Audio, visual, and gameplay settings.
- **ui/pregame/PreGameScreen.gd** — Pre-match tactical setup, formation change, and lineup selection.
- **ui/pause/PauseMenu.gd** — In-match pause menu, resume, tactical adjustments, restart.
- **autoloads/GameEvents.gd** — Global signal hub routing all inter-system events across layers.
- **autoloads/GameManager.gd** — Single source of truth for match lifecycle, score, clock, and set-piece states.
- **autoloads/InputHelper.gd** — Human controller input abstraction and mapping.
</layer_5_narrative>

---

## 3. Tooling & Automation

<tooling>
- **tools/verify_gate.py** — Unified verification orchestrator running --fast (<150ms post-write gate) and --full (pre-turn completion battery).
- **tools/lint_invariants.py** — Domain-specific AST invariant linter enforcing layer separation, zero allocations, collision matrix, and choke points.
- **tools/lint_scope.py** — Postmortem AST scope linter catching duplicate variable declarations and dead code across function blocks.
- **tools/lint_type_comparisons.py** — Postmortem type safety linter preventing Object vs String/StringName equality comparisons.
- **tools/lint_stringnames.py** — StringName literal linter enforcing `&"string_name"` on signal and metadata invocations.
- **tools/lint_shadowing.py** — Parameter shadowing linter preventing collisions with member variables and autoload singletons.
- **tools/lint_allocations.py** — Allocation & distance-sorting linter enforcing `distance_squared_to()` and zero transient RNG instantiations.
- **tools/lint_signal_races.py** — Signal race condition linter enforcing state variable updates prior to signal dispatch.
- **tools/audit_process_modes.py** — Process mode consistency auditor verifying pausable entities vs always-processing coordinators.
- **tools/replay_test.py** — Deterministic headless simulation replay harness asserting frame-for-frame bit-exact identity across seeds.
- **tools/fuzz_formations.py** — Dynamic formation anchor property fuzzer asserting 100% boundary safety and depth ordering across 50,000 iterations.
- **tools/benchmark_math.py** — Mathematical solvers micro-benchmark suite measuring throughput and execution latency.
- **tools/generate_symbols.py** — Lightweight symbolic indexer generating `docs/SYMBOLS.json` line-indexed symbol map.
- **tools/codebase_slice.py** — Targeted code slicing CLI utility extracting functions, enums, signals, or class headers.
- **tools/semantic_search.py** — Zero-dependency local BM25 knowledge retrieval querying rules, specs, and docstrings.
- **tools/git_pre_commit.py** — Git pre-commit hook installer and complete verification suite runner.
- **tools/tscn_linter.py** — Scene graph and resource resolver validating ext_resource paths, node hierarchies, and collision layer masks.
- **tools/validate_schemas.py** — Strict JSON Schema and physical invariant validator for club databases (league, managers, referees).
- **tools/fuzz_solvers.py** — Property-based mathematical solvers and kinematic fuzz tester (100,000 randomized iterations).
- **tools/spatial_grid_bench.py** — 22-entity spatial query latency benchmark across multiple grid cell sizes.
- **tools/dump_match_frames.py** — Multimodal top-down SVG frame slice generator for visual evaluation.
- **tools/formation_ascii.py** — Terminal ASCII pitch renderer for tactical formations across match phases.
- **tools/eval_simulation.py** — Headless simulation assertion harness and runtime telemetry evaluator.
- **tools/dump_dep_graph.py** — Static dependency DAG builder and blast radius query tool exporting to `docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json`.
- **tools/gdcheck.py** — Static GDScript checker enforcing typing, valid identifiers, and Godot 4.7 API compliance.
- **tools/hook_gdcheck.py** — Combined verification hook runner with XML diagnostic reporting.
- **tools/verify_db.py** — Comprehensive database schema and constraint verification tool.
- **tools/dump_api.py** — Automated public API surface extractor generating `docs/API_SURFACE.md`.
- **tools/mcp_server.py** — Standard stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agent tooling and introspection.
- **tools/lsp_client.py** — Godot Language Server Protocol client with local static diagnostic fallback.
- **tools/worktree_manager.py** — Automated git worktree isolation and verification sandbox manager.
- **tools/compact_errata.py** — Errata compaction tool promoting discovered rules and archiving old session state.
- **tools/sync_rules.py** — Tool promoting rules from `AGENTS_ERRATA.md` to `.claude/rules/` and `docs/CORE_INVARIANTS.md`.
- **tools/next_task.py** — Tool querying `ROADMAP.md` for the next unchecked Phase 1 gameplay task and relevant file context.
- **tools/layer_context.py** — Targeted context injector for simulation layers 1–5.
- **.antigravity/commands.json** — Custom slash commands (`/verify-all`, `/slice`, `/search`, `/benchmark`, `/fuzz-formations`, `/replay-test`, `/gen-symbols`, `/lint-invariants`, `/eval-sim`, `/fuzz-solvers`, `/formation-audit`, `/blast-radius`, `/dump-dep-graph`, `/sync-rules`, `/compact-errata`, `/rebuild-api`, `/next-task`, `/layer-ctx`).
- **.antigravity/hooks.json** — Lifecycle verification hooks.
- **.antigravity/skills/** — Antigravity workflow skills (`eval-sim`, `ast-refactor`, `formation-audit`, `formation-fuzzer`, `perf-benchmark`).
</tooling>
- autoloads/CareerManager.gd                   # Career state + day loop (Layer 4)
- autoloads/WorldEventLog.gd                   # Club-world history -> PressOffice (Layer 5)
- shared/career/                               # Career data model + engines (18 Resources)
- shared/career/MoraleEngine.gd                # Career -> MoodSystem/TrustSystem bridge
- shared/career/CareerSerializer.gd            # JSON save/load, 3 slots, versioned
- ui/manager_mode/ManagerModeRoot.gd           # FM-style career shell (13 sections)
- .claude/rules/career-mode.md                 # Career layer contracts
- tools/lint_xref.py                           # Qualified-member + res:// path checker
